analysis: This PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: a date bump, a new paragraph on the cluster service heartbeat env var (DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE, service-health.json vs part-health.json), and a rewrite of the 'Cluster runtime facts of an installed app' section (head lines ~5230-5284). The rewrite describes a signed release computing and registering cluster_runtime approvals, pair-serving grants, public model declarations and parity qualifications. No executable code, auth logic or keys change, so there is no direct regression to the TB-002, TB-009, TB-011 or T-041 controls. The two visible units are text excerpts, and the heartbeat hunk (base ~3525) is only in the patch excerpt, which is truncated. Items for the integration pass: (1) The documented split between service and part health files is a claim about supervisor liveness. The guard accepts only a beat with the service's own PID and the part waits for registration as a supervised member. The Swift code (ClusterServiceAgent, ClusterService.partEnvironment) was not supplied, so it is unverified. (2) The doc says grants for undeclared models are built from bundled records and declared models from ClusterPublicModels evidence digests. The coordinator enforcement links pin external platform commits, and this was not verifiable here. (3) The doc states a coordinator holds pair members without a grant to single-Mac requirements. This is platform-owned and outside this repo's scope. None of this indicates a threat-model invalidation; the changes are descriptive. No findings.
